mapper.insert: insert into carts (merchant_id, family_id, user_id, meal_slot_id, service_date, expected_meal_time, remark, status,version) values (#{merchantId}, #{familyId}, #{memberId}, #{mealSlotId}, #{serviceDate}, #{expectedMealTime}, #{remark}, #{status},#{version})
mapper.select: select d.id as dishId, d.name as dishName, coalesce(fmd.final_price, d.base_price) as price from family_menu_items fmd join dishes d on d.id = fmd.dish_id where fmd.family_id = #{familyId} and fmd.dish_id = #{dishId} and fmd.enabled = 1 and d.status = 'active' limit 1
select count(*) from meal_slots where id = #{mealSlotId} and family_id = #{familyId} and enabled = 1

mapper.insert: insert into cart_items (cart_id, dish_id, dish_name_snapshot, price, quantity, item_remark) values (#{cartId}, #{dishId}, #{dishNameSnapshot}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{itemRemark})
mapper.select: select cis.id,cis.cart_item_id,cis.user_id,cis.quantity,cis.item_remark from cart_item_selections cis where cis.cart_item_id=#{itemId} and cis.user_id=#{userId} for update

select cis.id,cis.cart_item_id,cis.user_id,coalesce(nullif(u.nickname,''),u.username) member_name,cis.quantity,cis.item_remark from cart_item_selections cis left join users u on u.id=cis.user_id where cis.cart_item_id=#{itemId} order by cis.user_id
select cis.id,cis.cart_item_id,cis.user_id,cis.quantity,cis.item_remark from cart_item_selections cis where cis.cart_item_id=#{itemId} order by cis.user_id for update
mapper.insert: insert into cart_item_selections(cart_item_id,user_id,quantity,item_remark) values(#{itemId},#{userId},#{quantity},#{remark}) on duplicate key update quantity=values(quantity),item_remark=values(item_remark)
mapper.delete: delete from cart_item_selections where cart_item_id=#{itemId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(quantity),0) from cart_item_selections where cart_item_id=#{itemId}
